narrative.overview:
The site reads like a zine made by the people who run the sessions: photocopy-cream paper, condensed headlines loud enough to read from across the hall, ruled listings, and pasted-on cut-outs (leaves, paper wings, a spinning "Free" badge, a scissor-marked newsletter coupon). It is joyful, loud and local. The loudness belongs to the type and the two saturated colours, grape and coral. The layout underneath stays plain, so a parent on a phone still finds when, where, who it's for and that it's free in one glance.

Hand-made touches go on the edges, never on the facts. Photos tilt a degree and a half, leaves turn ±18–30° next to section labels, and a coral block sits offset behind the event poster. Dates, times, venues and buttons stay square and straight, and the facts are set in plain Karla rather than in caps. Everything is flat: no box shadows, no gradients except the hero's legibility overlay, no rounded corners except the badge circle. Depth comes from overlap and rotation, like layers of paper.

Density depends on the job. Section openers are big and sparse (a display heading over a short intro). Listings are tight rows divided by rules. Proof is always real: consented footage and photos from the organisation's own sessions, the team's portraits, families' own words. Never stock imagery of children.
keyCharacteristics: Big Shoulders Display at weight 900, uppercase, line-height 0.9, balanced, for every heading and every date.
Five display roles and four text roles, named in `@theme`; no ad-hoc sizes.
Three grounds only: cream, grape and ink. Each one has its own fixed text and rule colours.
Coral carries the heading's starred words, the main call to action and the next date.
Listings are ruled rows (a 3px ink top rule, 1.5px dividers) with a peach hover band.
Square corners, 2px ink outlines, DM Mono caps for labels and buttons, and square-ended SVG icons.
Cut-out decoration (leaves, paper wings, a dashed coupon edge, tilted photos) sits only at the edges.

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: A section sits on cream, grape or ink, nothing else. On cream: grape headings, coral starred words, ink text and rules. On grape and ink: cream headings, lilac body, coral-soft eyebrows, cream solid rules and lilac-dash (grape) or mauve-line (ink) dashed rules.

rules.name: The Coral Text Rule
rules.body: Coral is text only on ink (6.2:1) or grape (3.6:1, display sizes only). On cream it measures 2.41:1, below AA even for large text, so coral words on cream use coral-deep. Today the site still uses plain coral on cream in several places: starred heading words on cream sections (`highlight()` in `src/lib/text.ts` defaults to `text-coral`), the coral word in the What's on, All sessions and 404 titles, the event page's next date, and pillar accents on the cream theme. That is a known AA gap, not a pattern to copy.

rules.name: The Hover-to-Ink Rule
rules.body: Every filled or outlined control turns ink with cream text on hover (outline-light on grape turns cream with grape text). Hover changes colour; nothing lifts, grows or casts a shadow.

rules.name: The Shout, Say, Label Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders shouts (headings, dates, names). Karla says: every sentence, and every fact a family needs (event names, times, venues, who it's for). DM Mono labels: kickers, buttons, nav, filters. A sentence never goes in display or mono, and facts never go in mono caps.

rules.name: The One Mono Size Rule
rules.body: DM Mono has one job and one size: the 14px `.label`. Smaller mono caps are hard to read on phones. Its `font-normal` is deliberate: only a 400 file exists, so mono inside bold text would be faked.

rules.name: The Named Role Rule
rules.body: Size text with a role class, never a pixel value. The only sizes outside the roles are the hero's lead and accent, and the badge text that scales with its container (`9.5cqi`).

rules.name: The Weights-in-Config Rule
rules.body: Only 800/900 display, 400/700 Karla and 400 mono are loaded, and nothing uses 800 now. Add a weight to the `fonts` config in `astro.config.mjs` before using it, or the browser fakes it.

rules.name: The Unbroken Compound Rule
rules.body: Editor text that is shown as a fact or lead ("under-5s", "grown-ups") goes through `keepCompounds()` (`src/lib/text.ts`), so short hyphenated words never break at the hyphen.

rules.name: The Ruled List Rule
rules.body: Every list of events, sessions or people starts with a 3px ink rule. Rows are divided by 1.5px solid ink on cream, or 1.5px dashed lilac-dash or mauve-line on dark grounds. The last row keeps its divider. Lists never sit in boxes.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand out, change its ground, rule weight or rotation, not its shadow.

dos: **Do** take every colour from the `@theme` tokens in `src/styles/tailwind.css` (`bg-grape`, `text-ink`, `border-lilac-dash`).
**Do** size type with the role classes (`text-title`, `text-heading`, `text-sub`, `text-item`, `text-lead`, `text-prose`, `text-body`, `text-small`) and use `.label` for every mono label.
**Do** start every listing with a 3px ink rule and divide its rows with 1.5px rules (the Ruled List Rule).
**Do** set every date in display type, grape on cream or coral on dark, and say "Free" up front with the grape price tag or the badge.
**Do** use coral-deep for coral text on cream; keep plain coral for fills, focus rings and text on ink or grape (the Coral Text Rule).
**Do** draw arrows, play/pause and scissors with `Icon.astro`; the fonts are Latin-only subsets with no arrow glyphs.
**Do** pass editor text shown as a fact or lead through `keepCompounds()`.
**Do** keep every tap target at least 44px tall.
**Do** keep the coral 2px focus outline with its 3px offset on everything focusable.
**Do** stop all motion under `prefers-reduced-motion`: the badge ring stops, and the hero video waits for Play.
**Do** let editors' asterisks choose the coral words. Don't hard-code coral spans in headings that come from Sanity.
**Do** use only consented footage and photos from the organisation's own sessions.
donts: **Don't** round corners, add box shadows, or add gradients outside the hero overlay (the Flat Paper Rule).
**Don't** put a section on any ground other than cream, grape or ink, or introduce new hues. The marigold and butter in the leaf SVGs stay inside the illustrations.
**Don't** use the legacy colour names (`text`, `primary`, `dark`, `light`) in new code; `primary` is coral, not grape.
**Don't** type Unicode arrows or symbols (→ ↗ ← ▶ ❚❚ ✂); they fall back to another font, thinner and off the baseline.
**Don't** set mono below 14px, or put sentences, times, venues or event names in mono or display.
**Don't** use pixel sizes for text, or a font weight that isn't in the fonts config.
**Don't** rotate text, icons, buttons, dates or form controls; tilt only images, colour blocks and cut-outs.
**Don't** make hover lift, scale or cast a shadow; it changes colour (and a listing row moves in 16px).
**Don't** use stock imagery of children, or invent statistics or badges of proof.
**Don't** box listings in cards; they are ruled rows on the page.
